description: Knowledge slice declarations (KP-03). Engineering pins (MSN-PSTACK-WIRE) plus company-ops marketing/design pins (MSN-BIZ-SKILLS). Extend from telemetry (KP-05).

slices.description: Implementers doing execution-phase work always get the working philosophy up front, and never see unreviewed auto-distilled placeholders that would crowd the budget with low-signal text.

Development missions pin the short pstack import index and search orchestration/ so playbooks stay findable without exhausting the M-scope hint budget (working-philosophy already occupies one pin slot).
Testers pin the verification-skill playbook and search orchestration for benchmark/success-check guidance without filling the entire hint budget.
Reviewers refute with blast-radius proof and contested-design wiring to existing independence roles.
Opposing-position role reads the Kyberion mapping of arena/interrogate intents.
Experience designers get intentional visual direction and marketing context before polishing UI or brand surfaces.
Product strategists get marketing context, strategy, and launch/GTM playbooks for company-facing decisions.
Designer authority role: visual direction plus content pipeline quality gates for customer-facing artifacts.
Marketing growth authority: product context, content pipeline, strategy, and launch/GTM foundations.

DA-07: demonstrates the tenant match dimension. '*' matches any concrete tenant (and tenantless requests, whose tenant normalizes to '*'); replace with a concrete slug (e.g. {"tenant": "tenant-masked-a"}) to declare per-tenant pinned/search_roots/exclude. The exclude below repeats the corpus-wide distill_ glob (excludes are unioned), so this slice adds no behavioral delta until a concrete tenant slice is declared.

Wildcard default applied to every task: auto-distilled evolution notes are placeholder-prone (many still contain 'None extracted automatically (policy fallback)') and pollute retrieval ranking, so they are excluded corpus-wide. Curated evolution docs (biometric_privacy.md, reconstruction-learnings-*, wisdom_*) are NOT matched by the distill_ glob and remain searchable.

Pinned: delegated workers on PRJ-KYBERION-PRODUCTIZATION must write requirements/design evidence through the governed CLI tools (scripts/requirements_draft.ts, scripts/design_spec.ts), never directly.
